name: 4696-sharedprefix-longchat7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 4, bounded at 400 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, one prefix bucket (bucket_weight 100, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 14800); prompt exactly 200 tokens and output exactly 16, so every request is 14800 shared + 200 unique = 15000 prompt tokens. `spec.backend.request_format: "plain"` is required, not optional: this checkpoint's tokenizer_config.json carries no chat_template, so the default request format raises.
purpose: A long-context document assistant answering brief questions over a shared 15,000-token dossier, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Engine: vLLM at commit c579b750a083931ad03ecac898aca5ad67c6c59c
# (2024-05, `git describe` -> v0.4.2-59-gc579b750a0839). Keys go to that era's AsyncEngineArgs
# as keyword arguments, so an unknown one is a TypeError: do not add flags from a later vLLM.
# Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml (per-machine, not portable).

model: lmsys/longchat-7b-16k

enable-prefix-caching: true
enforce-eager: true

max-model-len: 16384
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
block-size: 16
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
